general.json: finite typed JSON, no duplicate keys; null only where declared
general.integer: exact integral non-Boolean values; CSV numeric notation is not restricted
general.npz_integral_axes: Exact integral non-Boolean numeric values; integer or finite float storage allowed when each required small integer key is exactly represented
general.row_order: ungraded; all required keys complete and unique
general.extras: Harmless finite extras within all method byte/entry/depth limits allowed; maximum32 NPZ dimensions applies to extras, required shapes remain fixed

columns.participant_source_row: original zero-based participants TSV row integer

cohort.csv.note: Complete fixed cohort; no outcome exclusions. Rank and active counts are source-authoritative computational diagnostics, not desired minima.

participant_ids.dtype: Unicode or bytes string, no objects

map_labels.dtype: Unicode or bytes string, no objects

visual_map_ids.values: original map IDs of Vis, Striate, Occ post, any coherent order

timecourses.npz.note: Raw full39 coefficients and final3 series are independently source-bound; no recomputation of cleaning from rounded raw receipts. All support flags source-canonical.

isc_pairs.csv.pair_orientation: unordered key; either orientation accepted but not both, exactly780 pairs per region

isc_per_subject.csv.note: Both diagnostics required regardless of headline; participant-level three-region values reside in results.

required.visual_isc: nullable real, selected estimator headline value

required.source_files: complete manifest file list reduced to exact path,role,participant_id nullable,size_bytes,sha256; row order ungraded
required.software_versions: object with nonempty actual versions for python,numpy,scipy,nibabel,nilearn; not_used allowed only for unused library

source_observed.confound_column_names: object literal participant ID to complete original TSV header list

run_metadata.json.header_nulls: raw_TR and raw_toffset may be null only for nonfinite source fields; all scientific arrays and effective scaling finite
run_metadata.json.dtype_aliases: Equivalent real dtype names/byte-order aliases accepted when scientifically identical
run_metadata.json.extras: Additional finite descriptive metadata is ungraded; it cannot override required identity or scientific fields. No timestamps/elapsed time/host paths required.

findings.md.requirement: nonempty UTF-8 free prose; no mandatory sign, ordering or interpretation phrases

failure.rule: Preserve partial evidence and stop; never emit misleading complete success or overwrite existing files.

pilot.rule: Explicit partial scope; does not satisfy full production schema counts or success. Parent-reviewed pilot command and comparison are separate from participant grading.
